# Coverage Depth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CoverageDepth>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The depth of coverage a source provides about its subject — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes significant in-depth treatment from passing mention or routine filing. This axis is orthogonal to source tier and independence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:coverageDepth`](../properties/gmeow-coverageDepth.md) — naming how substantially a source treats its subject (significant coverage, passing mention, routine filing) for notability assessment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with source tier ([`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md)) or independence ([`gmeow:SourceIndependence`](gmeow-SourceIndependence.md)) — depth is orthogonal to both — and avoid per-value subclasses; the depths are individuals.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded depth individuals via [`gmeow:coverageDepth`](../properties/gmeow-coverageDepth.md) on the citation; a passing mention or routine filing can still verify a fact ([`Axis`](gmeow-Axis.md) A) without supporting notability, so pair it with [`gmeow:supportsNotability`](../properties/gmeow-supportsNotability.md) and let competing assessments coexist.

### Examples

- ex:inDepth a [`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "significant coverage"@en.
